prompts.title: Instagram Flash Restyle
prompts.prompt:

Preserve the exact same person, face, expression, pose, outfit, hairstyle, objects, background, framing, and composition. Make the environment cooler, moodier, and richer, with a strong green-cyan / teal ambience and deeper night density, while keeping the original scene recognizable. The background should become darker and cooler than the subject, but not muddy or fully black.
The subject treatment is critical: light the subject with a strong direct on-camera frontal flash that is clearly visible in the result. The flash must dominate the subject more than the ambient light. The face, skin, hair, and clothing facing the camera should look brighter, flatter, more directly flash-lit, and slightly lifted in exposure. The subject should appear more illuminated and more separated from the surroundings, like a real camera-flash snapshot, not a softly relit portrait. Keep the skin warm, bright, glowing, and flash-washed, while the surroundings stay cooler and darker.
If reflective, glossy, metallic, leather, glass, polished, or shiny surfaces are present, show realistic small flash reflections / specular pops where appropriate. If the scene geometry naturally allows it, include a believable subtle hard-edged flash shadow behind the subject or nearby objects, but only where it would occur naturally.

If the original image already contains noise or compression texture, do not clean it up — blend it naturally into the overall grain structure.
The final result should look like the same original photo captured at night with a strong direct camera flash, featuring richer green-cyan ambience, a much more obviously flash-lit subject, visible film grain, visible noise, and a filtered Instagram Flash look.

prompts.title: Unspoken Words
prompts.prompt:
Composition & Layout:
A vertically stacked three-frame cinematic triptych (top → middle → bottom), perfectly aligned with equal width and seamless transitions between panels.
NO borders, NO gaps, NO dividers — the three panels must appear as one continuous stacked composition.
Each panel represents a different crop of the SAME subject, SAME environment, SAME lighting conditions, and SAME moment in time.
Final output aspect ratio: 4:5 vertical.
Environment & Background:
A vast open dry golden field stretching toward a soft horizon with distant rolling hills.
Sky features a warm sunset gradient—soft orange, peach, and subtle pink tones blending into muted twilight.
No buildings, no modern elements, no extra people. Pure natural landscape.
Background remains consistent across all panels (only depth of field changes).
Lighting:
Golden hour lighting with the sun positioned low near the horizon.
Soft cinematic backlight combined with subtle front fill to avoid underexposure on face and outfit.
Warm tones, diffused light, gentle highlights on hair and skin.
No harsh shadows, no overexposure, no lighting inconsistency across panels.
Outfit & Styling:
Maroon/burgundy textured jacket (corduroy-like), worn open over an off-white/cream t-shirt.
Minimal silver chain necklace visible.
Natural fabric texture clearly visible—fine details, no unrealistic shine.
Accessories: subtle silver ring.
Hair slightly messy, natural movement—no over-styling.
Panel Breakdown
Panel 1 (Top – Wide / Medium Shot):
Framing: Chest-up to mid-torso shot with environmental context visible
Pose: Subject turned slightly away from camera, head tilted looking toward the horizon (off-frame sun)
Expression: Calm, contemplative, thoughtful
Composition: Subject centered, maintaining cinematic negative space
Background: Clear view of field and distant hills
Panel 2 (Middle – Medium Close Shot):
Framing: Tight waist-up / chest-up portrait
Pose: Head tilted downward, Right hand running through hair naturally
Expression: Introspective, slightly emotional, grounded
Detail: Ring visible on fingers, natural hand tension
Focus: Balanced between face, hand, and outfit texture
Panel 3 (Bottom – Tight Close-Up Profile):
Framing: Close-up side profile
Pose: Subject looking downward/right, holding a small dried flower delicately near face
Expression: Quiet, reflective, intimate mood
Depth of Field: Very shallow (strong background blur)
Focus: Sharp on face + object, soft cinematic bokeh in background
Camera & Technical Details:
Camera: Full-frame mirrorless (Canon EOS R5 / Sony A7R V equivalent)
Lens: 35mm for top panel, 50mm feel for middle, ~85mm close-up compression for bottom
Aperture: f/2.0 – f/2.8 (shallow depth of field progression)
ISO: 100–200
Shutter: ~1/400 – 1/800
Ultra-sharp focus on subject, natural falloff in background
Color & Style:
Cinematic, film-like color grading
Warm earthy palette: maroon, golden yellow, amber, soft orange, muted sky tones
Subtle natural grain (not heavy)
High dynamic range but soft contrast (no harsh clipping)
Strict Rules:
SAME face, SAME background, SAME lighting across all panels
ONLY change: framing + pose + crop
No extra subjects
No artificial effects, no over-stylization
Maintain realism, texture, and natural imperfections

prompts.title: Old Photo Restoration
prompts.prompt:
SUBJECT
Identity Lock: Absolute preservation of facial geometry and body proportions; Identity Similarity Threshold $\ge 0.95$.
Epidermal Fidelity: Execute macro-level epidermal texture synthesis to avoid "plastic" smoothing. Restore natural material skin-pore structures, textile weaves, and era-specific surfaces.
Classification & Damage: Autonomous Origin Detection (Real/Synthetic/Ambiguous). Apply DamageScore (0–100) and RegionConfidence (RC).
RC $\ge 70$: Context-guided high-detail reconstruction.
RC 30–69: Coarse-to-medium structural restoration; zero semantic invention.
RC $< 30$: Era-consistent silhouette/texture fill only.
Safe Reconstruction Logic: Area-based constraints: $< 10\%$ (Guided inpainting), $10\text{--}40\%$ (Structural geometry synthesis), $> 40\%$ (Texture-only pass).
COMPOSITION
Frame Integrity: Strict adherence to original aspect ratio, framing, and semantic positioning. No object injection or removal.
Perspective & Scale: Enforce rigorous vanishing point alignment and geometric continuity.
Spatial Physics: Validate structural synthesis against surrounding geometry to ensure physical plausibility. Revert to "Safe Fill" if PhysicsCheck fails.
LIGHTING
Global Illumination: Restore Chiaroscuro-level lighting depth while maintaining consistent shadow direction and luminance gradients.
Material Reflectance: Physically accurate reconstruction of light interaction with surfaces (specular highlights, matte finishes).
Chromatic Consistency: Restore faded tones to era-correct palettes with modern High Dynamic Range (HDR). Maintain vintage warmth/analog character through spectral-aware color fidelity.
TECHNICAL SPECS
Restoration Pipeline: Sub-pixel deconvolution, motion-blur neutralization, and chromatic aberration correction.
Super-Resolution: Execute Multi-stage 4x+ Super-Resolution with an anti-artifact refinement pass.
Noise Management: Intelligent separation of sensor noise vs. compression artifacts; preserve original analog grain structure while removing degradational "noise."
Output Parameters: Lossless 16-bit PNG/TIFF; Archival and sRGB color space integration; Metadata/EXIF preservation. Zero watermarks/logos/identifying marks altered.
